using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

// Generated by the Warboard v35 structural refactor.
// Method bodies were moved verbatim from GameController.cs.
public partial class GameController : MonoBehaviour
{
    // WARBOARD_V36_DIRECT_MOVEMENT_EVENTS
    private void CreateMoveRing()
    {
        GameObject go =
            new GameObject(
                "ActionRangeGuide"
            );

        moveRing =
            go.AddComponent<LineRenderer>();

        moveRing.loop = true;
        moveRing.useWorldSpace = true;
        moveRing.positionCount = 128;
        moveRing.widthMultiplier = 0.055f;

        Shader shader =
            Shader.Find(
                "Sprites/Default"
            );

        if (shader != null)
        {
            moveRing.material =
                new Material(shader);
        }

        SetActionRangeRingColor(
            new Color(
                0.15f,
                0.75f,
                1f,
                0.95f
            )
        );

        moveRing.enabled = false;

        CreateMovementCursorLine();
    }

    private void CreateMovementCursorLine()
    {
        if (movementCursorLine != null)
            return;

        GameObject go =
            new GameObject(
                "MovementCursorDistanceGuide"
            );

        movementCursorLine =
            go.AddComponent<LineRenderer>();

        movementCursorLine.loop = false;
        movementCursorLine.useWorldSpace = true;
        movementCursorLine.positionCount = 2;
        movementCursorLine.widthMultiplier = 0.07f;
        movementCursorLine.numCapVertices = 5;

        Shader shader =
            Shader.Find(
                "Sprites/Default"
            );

        if (shader != null)
        {
            movementCursorLine.material =
                new Material(shader);
        }

        movementCursorLine.startColor =
            new Color(
                0.16f,
                0.82f,
                1f,
                0.98f
            );

        movementCursorLine.endColor =
            movementCursorLine.startColor;

        movementCursorLine.enabled = false;
    }

    private void SetMovementCursorLineColor(
        Color color)
    {
        if (movementCursorLine == null)
            return;

        movementCursorLine.startColor =
            color;

        movementCursorLine.endColor =
            color;
    }

    private float SelectedModelRemainingMove()
    {
        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            selectedModel == null)
        {
            return 0f;
        }

        float allowance =
            selectedSquad
                .GetMovementAllowanceFor(
                    selectedModel
                );

        float alreadyMoved =
            selectedModel
                .DistanceMovedFromTurnStart(
                    selectedModel
                        .transform.position
                );

        return
            Mathf.Max(
                0f,
                allowance -
                alreadyMoved
            );
    }

    private void HideMovementCursorMeasure()
    {
        movementCursorMeasureActive =
            false;

        movementCursorMeasureText = "";

        if (movementCursorLine != null)
            movementCursorLine.enabled = false;
    }

    private void ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
        Vector3 start,
        Vector3 end,
        string text,
        bool legal,
        Color normalColor)
    {
        if (movementCursorLine == null)
            CreateMovementCursorLine();

        start.y = 0.085f;
        end.y = 0.085f;

        movementCursorLine.enabled = true;

        movementCursorLine.SetPosition(
            0,
            start
        );

        movementCursorLine.SetPosition(
            1,
            end
        );

        movementCursorMeasureActive =
            true;

        movementCursorMeasureText =
            text ?? "";

        movementCursorMeasureLegal =
            legal;

        SetMovementCursorLineColor(
            legal
            ? normalColor
            : new Color(
                1f,
                0.22f,
                0.18f,
                1f
              )
        );
    }

    private void UpdateMovementCursorMeasure()
    {
        HideMovementCursorMeasure();

        bool rulerHeld =
            Input.GetKey(
                KeyCode.LeftAlt
            ) ||
            Input.GetKey(
                KeyCode.RightAlt
            );

        if (!rulerHeld)
            return;

        if (battleSetupMode ||
            armyImportMode ||
            missionSetupMode ||
            battleOver ||
            deploymentMode ||
            reservePlacementSquad != null ||
            showDatasheet ||
            showRuleChoiceWindow ||
            showStratagemReaction ||
            showStratagemMenu ||
            traditionalAttackPending ||
            interactiveAttack != null)
        {
            return;
        }

        Vector3 cursor;

        if (!TryCursorPointOnBattlefield(
                out cursor))
        {
            return;
        }

        // Special / faction movement uses the unit centre and its explicit
        // maximum distance.
        if (specialMoveSquad != null)
        {
            Vector3 start =
                specialMoveSquad
                    .CurrentCentre();

            float distance =
                HorizontalDistance(
                    start,
                    cursor
                );

            bool legal =
                InsideBoard(
                    cursor) &&
                distance <=
                    specialMoveMaxDistance +
                    0.001f;

            ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                start,
                cursor,
                distance.ToString("0.0") +
                "″ / " +
                specialMoveMaxDistance
                    .ToString("0.0") +
                "″  •  " +
                specialMoveLabel,
                legal,
                new Color(
                    0.74f,
                    0.44f,
                    1f,
                    0.98f
                )
            );

            return;
        }

        if (phase == Phase.Fight &&
            fightActivationUnit != null &&
            selectedModel != null &&
            ModelBelongsToFightActivation(
                selectedModel))
        {
            Vector3 start =
                selectedModel
                    .transform.position;

            if (fightActivationStage ==
                    FightActivationStage.PileIn ||
                fightActivationStage ==
                    FightActivationStage.Consolidate)
            {
                Vector3 stageStart;

                if (!fightStageStartPositions
                    .TryGetValue(
                        selectedModel,
                        out stageStart))
                {
                    stageStart = start;
                }

                float segment =
                    HorizontalDistance(
                        start,
                        cursor
                    );

                float total =
                    HorizontalDistance(
                        stageStart,
                        cursor
                    );

                float limit =
                    FightStageMoveLimit();

                string reason;

                bool legal =
                    FightStageDestinationLegal(
                        selectedModel,
                        cursor,
                        out reason
                    );

                ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                    start,
                    cursor,
                    segment.ToString("0.0") +
                    "″ segment  •  " +
                    total.ToString("0.0") +
                    "/" +
                    limit.ToString("0.0") +
                    "″ " +
                    (fightActivationStage ==
                        FightActivationStage.PileIn
                        ? "pile-in"
                        : "consolidate"),
                    legal,
                    fightActivationStage ==
                        FightActivationStage.PileIn
                    ? new Color(
                        0.66f,
                        0.32f,
                        1.0f,
                        0.98f
                      )
                    : new Color(
                        0.20f,
                        0.90f,
                        0.52f,
                        0.98f
                      )
                );

                return;
            }

            if (fightActivationStage ==
                    FightActivationStage.Attacks &&
                !fightModelsResolvedThisActivation
                    .Contains(
                        selectedModel))
            {
                float distance =
                    HorizontalDistance(
                        start,
                        cursor
                    );

                ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                    start,
                    cursor,
                    distance.ToString("0.0") +
                    "″  •  melee range " +
                    EngagementRange.ToString("0.#") +
                    "″",
                    distance <=
                        EngagementRange +
                        0.001f &&
                    InsideBoard(
                        cursor
                    ),
                    new Color(
                        1f,
                        0.32f,
                        0.18f,
                        0.98f
                    )
                );

                return;
            }
        }

        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            !selectedSquad.IsAlive ||
            selectedSquad.FactionId !=
                activeFaction)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (phase == Phase.Move)
        {
            if (wholeSquadMoveMode)
            {
                Vector3 start =
                    selectedSquad
                        .CurrentCentre();

                Vector3 delta =
                    cursor -
                    start;

                delta.y = 0f;

                float distance =
                    HorizontalMagnitude(
                        delta
                    );

                bool legal =
                    InsideBoard(
                        cursor) &&
                    selectedSquad
                        .CanTranslateWithinNormalMove(
                            delta
                        );

                ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                    start,
                    cursor,
                    distance.ToString("0.0") +
                    "″  •  formation translation",
                    legal,
                    new Color(
                        0.16f,
                        0.82f,
                        1f,
                        0.98f
                    )
                );

                return;
            }

            if (selectedModel != null &&
                selectedModel.IsAlive)
            {
                Vector3 start =
                    selectedModel
                        .transform.position;

                Vector3 destination =
                    cursor;

                destination.y =
                    start.y;

                float segment =
                    HorizontalDistance(
                        start,
                        destination
                    );

                float total =
                    selectedModel
                        .DistanceMovedFromTurnStart(
                            destination
                        );

                float allowance =
                    selectedSquad
                        .GetMovementAllowanceFor(
                            selectedModel
                        );

                bool legal =
                    total <=
                        allowance +
                        0.001f &&
                    InsideBoard(
                        destination
                    ) &&
                    CanPlaceModel(
                        selectedModel,
                        destination
                    );

                string text =
                    segment.ToString("0.0") +
                    "″";

                if (selectedModel
                    .DistanceMovedFromTurnStart(
                        start) >
                    0.01f)
                {
                    text +=
                        " segment  •  " +
                        total.ToString("0.0") +
                        "/" +
                        allowance.ToString("0.0") +
                        "″ total";
                }
                else
                {
                    text +=
                        " / " +
                        allowance.ToString("0.0") +
                        "″";
                }

                ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                    start,
                    cursor,
                    text,
                    legal,
                    new Color(
                        0.16f,
                        0.82f,
                        1f,
                        0.98f
                    )
                );

                return;
            }
        }

        // The Charge phase still uses the charge solver for placement, but
        // the selected model now acts as a live tabletop ruler while the
        // player is choosing / checking a target.
        if (phase == Phase.Charge &&
            selectedModel != null &&
            selectedModel.IsAlive &&
            SelectedUnitCanCharge())
        {
            Vector3 start =
                selectedModel
                    .transform.position;

            float distance =
                HorizontalDistance(
                    start,
                    cursor
                );

            bool legal =
                InsideBoard(
                    cursor) &&
                distance <=
                    12f +
                    0.001f;

            ShowMovementCursorMeasure(
                start,
                cursor,
                distance.ToString("0.0") +
                "″  •  max 12″",
                legal,
                new Color(
                    1f,
                    0.30f,
                    0.18f,
                    0.98f
                )
            );
        }
    }

    private void RefreshMoveRing()
    {
        if (moveRing == null)
            return;

        moveRing.enabled = false;

        string rangeFaction =
            phase == Phase.Fight &&
            fightSequenceActive
            ? fightSelectionFaction
            : activeFaction;

        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            !selectedSquad.IsAlive ||
            selectedSquad.FactionId !=
                rangeFaction)
        {
            return;
        }

        Vector3 centre =
            Vector3.zero;

        float radius = 0f;

        if (phase == Phase.Move)
        {
            if (wholeSquadMoveMode)
            {
                centre =
                    selectedSquad
                        .CurrentCentre();

                radius =
                    selectedSquad.GetMove() +
                    selectedSquad
                        .BattleFocusMoveBonus +
                    (selectedSquad.HasAdvanced
                        ? selectedSquad
                            .AdvanceBonus
                        : 0);

                SetActionRangeRingColor(
                    new Color(
                        0.15f,
                        0.75f,
                        1f,
                        0.95f
                    )
                );
            }
            else if (selectedModel != null)
            {
                // Single-model movement is displayed from the actual model
                // that was clicked, using only its remaining movement.
                centre =
                    selectedModel
                        .transform.position;

                radius =
                    SelectedModelRemainingMove();

                SetActionRangeRingColor(
                    new Color(
                        0.15f,
                        0.75f,
                        1f,
                        0.95f
                    )
                );
            }
        }
        else if (phase == Phase.Shoot &&
                 selectedModel != null &&
                 !selectedSquad.HasShot)
        {
            centre =
                selectedModel
                    .transform.position;

            radius =
                SelectedModelMaximumRangedRange();

            SetActionRangeRingColor(
                new Color(
                    1.0f,
                    0.72f,
                    0.16f,
                    0.95f
                )
            );
        }
        else if (phase == Phase.Charge &&
                 selectedModel != null &&
                 SelectedUnitCanCharge())
        {
            centre =
                selectedModel
                    .transform.position;

            // A Charge roll is 2D6, so 12" is the maximum pre-roll threat
            // guide. Actual charge movement still uses the rolled value and
            // full unit/coherency/target legality.
            radius = 12f;

            SetActionRangeRingColor(
                new Color(
                    1.0f,
                    0.28f,
                    0.18f,
                    0.95f
                )
            );
        }
        else if (phase == Phase.Fight &&
                 selectedModel != null &&
                 fightActivationUnit != null &&
                 ModelBelongsToFightActivation(
                     selectedModel))
        {
            centre =
                selectedModel
                    .transform.position;

            if (fightActivationStage ==
                    FightActivationStage.PileIn ||
                fightActivationStage ==
                    FightActivationStage.Consolidate)
            {
                float limit =
                    FightStageMoveLimit();

                Vector3 start;

                if (!fightStageStartPositions
                    .TryGetValue(
                        selectedModel,
                        out start))
                {
                    start =
                        selectedModel
                            .transform.position;
                }

                float used =
                    HorizontalDistance(
                        start,
                        selectedModel
                            .transform.position
                    );

                radius =
                    Mathf.Max(
                        0f,
                        limit - used
                    );

                SetActionRangeRingColor(
                    fightActivationStage ==
                        FightActivationStage.PileIn
                    ? new Color(
                        0.66f,
                        0.32f,
                        1.0f,
                        0.95f
                      )
                    : new Color(
                        0.20f,
                        0.90f,
                        0.52f,
                        0.95f
                      )
                );
            }
            else if (fightActivationStage ==
                     FightActivationStage.Attacks &&
                     !fightModelsResolvedThisActivation
                         .Contains(
                             selectedModel))
            {
                radius =
                    EngagementRange;

                SetActionRangeRingColor(
                    new Color(
                        1.0f,
                        0.32f,
                        0.18f,
                        0.95f
                    )
                );
            }
        }

        if (radius <= 0.001f)
            return;

        centre.y = 0.065f;

        moveRing.enabled = true;

        for (int i = 0;
             i <
             moveRing.positionCount;
             i++)
        {
            float angle =
                i /
                (float)
                moveRing.positionCount *
                Mathf.PI *
                2f;

            moveRing.SetPosition(
                i,
                centre +
                new Vector3(
                    Mathf.Cos(angle) *
                        radius,
                    0f,
                    Mathf.Sin(angle) *
                        radius
                )
            );
        }
    }

    private void SelectWholeSquadForMovement(
        SquadController squad)
    {
        ClearSelectionVisualOnly();

        selectedSquad = squad;
        selectedModel = null;
        wholeSquadMoveMode = true;

        selectedSquad.SetSelected(true);
        selectedSquad.HighlightWholeSquad();

        if (selectedSquad.AttachedLeader != null)
        {
            selectedSquad.AttachedLeader.SetSelected(true);
            selectedSquad.AttachedLeader.HighlightWholeSquad();
        }

        status =
            "WHOLE SQUAD MOVE: " +
            selectedSquad.DisplayName +
            ". Click the board to translate the formation. " +
            "Every model must remain within its own move allowance.";

        RefreshMoveRing();
    }

    private void SyncAttachedLeaderAfterBodyguardMove(
        SquadController bodyguard)
    {
        if (bodyguard == null ||
            bodyguard.AttachedLeader == null ||
            !bodyguard.AttachedLeader.IsAlive ||
            !bodyguard.AttachedLeader.IsOnBattlefield)
        {
            return;
        }

        SquadController leader =
            bodyguard.AttachedLeader;

        if (leader.DistanceTo(bodyguard) <=
            2.0f + 0.05f)
        {
            return;
        }

        ModelToken leaderModel =
            leader.LivingModelTokens()
                .FirstOrDefault();

        if (leaderModel == null)
            return;

        ModelToken nearestBodyguard =
            bodyguard.ClosestLivingModelTo(
                leaderModel.transform.position
            );

        if (nearestBodyguard == null)
            return;

        Vector3 direction =
            leaderModel.transform.position -
            nearestBodyguard.transform.position;

        direction.y = 0f;

        if (direction.sqrMagnitude <
            0.001f)
        {
            direction = Vector3.back;
        }

        direction.Normalize();

        float[] angleOffsets =
        {
            0f, 30f, -30f,
            60f, -60f,
            90f, -90f,
            180f
        };

        foreach (float angle
            in angleOffsets)
        {
            Vector3 radial =
                Quaternion.Euler(
                    0f,
                    angle,
                    0f
                ) *
                direction;

            float leaderSpacing =
                MinimumModelSeparation(
                    nearestBodyguard,
                    leaderModel
                ) +
                0.06f;

            Vector3 candidate =
                nearestBodyguard.transform.position +
                radial *
                leaderSpacing;

            candidate.y =
                leaderModel.transform.position.y;

            if (!InsideBoard(candidate))
                continue;

            if (!CanPlaceModel(
                leaderModel,
                candidate))
            {
                continue;
            }

            leaderModel.transform.position =
                candidate;

            Physics.SyncTransforms();

            if (leader.DistanceTo(bodyguard) <=
                2.0f + 0.05f)
            {
                leader.RefreshVisuals();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void TranslateAttachedLeader(
        SquadController bodyguard,
        Vector3 delta)
    {
        if (bodyguard == null ||
            bodyguard.AttachedLeader == null ||
            !bodyguard.AttachedLeader.IsAlive ||
            !bodyguard.AttachedLeader.IsOnBattlefield)
        {
            return;
        }

        bodyguard.AttachedLeader
            .TranslateLivingModels(delta);

        Physics.SyncTransforms();
    }

    private void TranslateJoinedModels(
        SquadController squad,
        Vector3 delta)
    {
        delta.y = 0f;

        foreach (ModelToken model
            in JoinedModels(squad))
        {
            model.transform.position +=
                delta;
        }

        squad.RefreshVisuals();

        if (squad.AttachedLeader != null)
            squad.AttachedLeader.RefreshVisuals();

        Physics.SyncTransforms();
    }

    private bool OfferSpiritMarkAfterMove(
        SquadController movingUnit,
        System.Action after)
    {
        if (movingUnit == null ||
            !movingUnit.IsAlive ||
            !movingUnit.IsOnBattlefield ||
            !FactionRuleSystem.UnitOrLeaderHasRule(
                movingUnit,
                "Spirit Mark"))
        {
            return false;
        }

        SquadController spiritseer =
            movingUnit.AttachedLeader != null &&
            UniversalRuleRegistry.UnitHasRule(
                movingUnit.AttachedLeader,
                "Spirit Mark")
            ? movingUnit.AttachedLeader
            : movingUnit;

        if (spiritseer.SpiritMarkUsedThisTurn)
            return false;

        List<SquadController> wraiths =
            squads
                .Where(
                    unit =>
                        unit != null &&
                        !unit.IsAttachedLeader &&
                        unit.IsAlive &&
                        unit.IsOnBattlefield &&
                        unit.FactionId ==
                            movingUnit.FactionId &&
                        unit.HasKeyword(
                            "wraith construct") &&
                        JoinedDistance(
                            movingUnit,
                            unit
                        ) <= 6.001f
                )
                .ToList();

        List<SquadController> enemies =
            squads
                .Where(
                    enemy =>
                        enemy != null &&
                        !enemy.IsAttachedLeader &&
                        enemy.IsAlive &&
                        enemy.IsOnBattlefield &&
                        enemy.FactionId !=
                            movingUnit.FactionId &&
                        JoinedModels(movingUnit).Any(
                            model =>
                                ModelHasLineOfSight(
                                    model,
                                    enemy
                                )
                        )
                )
                .ToList();

        if (wraiths.Count == 0 ||
            enemies.Count == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        List<RuleChoiceOption> options =
            new List<RuleChoiceOption>();

        foreach (SquadController wraith
            in wraiths)
        {
            foreach (SquadController enemy
                in enemies)
            {
                SquadController capturedWraith =
                    wraith;

                SquadController capturedEnemy =
                    enemy;

                options.Add(
                    new RuleChoiceOption(
                        capturedWraith.DisplayName +
                        " → " +
                        capturedEnemy.DisplayName,
                        () =>
                        {
                            CloseRuleChoice();

                            capturedWraith.SpiritMarkTarget =
                                capturedEnemy;

                            spiritseer.SpiritMarkUsedThisTurn =
                                true;

                            status =
                                "SPIRIT MARK: " +
                                capturedWraith.DisplayName +
                                " gains Sustained Hits 1 against " +
                                capturedEnemy.DisplayName +
                                " until the start of your next Movement phase.";

                            if (after != null)
                                after();
                        }
                    )
                );
            }
        }

        options.Add(
            new RuleChoiceOption(
                "Skip Spirit Mark",
                () =>
                {
                    CloseRuleChoice();
                    spiritseer.SpiritMarkUsedThisTurn = true;

                    if (after != null)
                        after();
                }
            )
        );

        OpenRuleChoice(
            "SPIRIT MARK",
            "The Spiritseer ended a move. Select one nearby Wraith Construct and one visible enemy unit.",
            options
        );

        return true;
    }

    private void TryDeclareAdvance()
    {
        if (phase != Phase.Move ||
            selectedSquad == null ||
            !selectedSquad.IsAlive ||
            selectedSquad.FactionId !=
                activeFaction)
        {
            status =
                "Select one of your units in the Move phase first.";
            return;
        }

        if (IsEngaged(selectedSquad))
        {
            status =
                "Engaged units cannot Advance.";
            return;
        }

        if (selectedSquad.HasFallenBack)
        {
            status =
                "A unit that is Falling Back cannot Advance.";
            return;
        }

        if (selectedSquad.HasMoved)
        {
            status =
                "Declare the Advance before moving the unit.";
            return;
        }

        if (selectedSquad.HasAdvanced)
        {
            status =
                selectedSquad.DisplayName +
                " already has an Advance roll of +" +
                selectedSquad.AdvanceBonus +
                ".";
            return;
        }

        SquadController unit =
            selectedSquad.JoinedActionController();

        if (!IsXcomMode)
        {
            traditionalAdvancePending = true;
            traditionalAdvanceUnit = unit;
            traditionalAdvanceResult = 1;

            OpenTraditionalDicePrompt(
                1
            );

            AppendBattleLog(
                "ADVANCE",
                unit.DisplayName,
                "Advance declared. Player resolves the D6 manually and enters the final movement bonus."
            );

            status =
                "TRADITIONAL ADVANCE: roll your D6 in the free tray, apply any tabletop rerolls yourself, then enter the final result.";

            return;
        }

        int roll =
            DiceRoller.RollD6(
                "Advance: " +
                unit.DisplayName
            );

        bool suddenStormReroll =
            unit.FactionSuddenStormActive &&
            unit.AttachedLeader != null &&
            unit.AttachedLeader.IsAlive &&
            unit.AttachedLeader.HasKeyword(
                "necrons") &&
            unit.AttachedLeader.HasKeyword(
                "character");

        bool eldritchRaidersReroll =
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules.CanRerollAdvance(
                unit
            );

        if (suddenStormReroll ||
            eldritchRaidersReroll)
        {
            int capturedRoll = roll;

            string rerollSource =
                suddenStormReroll
                ? "PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM"
                : "YRIEL'S OWN";

            OpenRuleChoice(
                rerollSource +
                " — ADVANCE",
                unit.DisplayName +
                " rolled " +
                capturedRoll +
                ". " +
                (suddenStormReroll
                    ? "Because it is led by a Necron Character, this Advance roll can be re-rolled."
                    : "Eldritch Raiders allows this Anhrathe/Rangers/Shroud Runners unit to re-roll its Advance roll."),
                new[]
                {
                    new RuleChoiceOption(
                        "Keep " + capturedRoll,
                        () =>
                        {
                            CloseRuleChoice();
                            ApplyAdvanceRoll(
                                unit,
                                capturedRoll
                            );
                        }
                    ),
                    new RuleChoiceOption(
                        "Re-roll Advance",
                        () =>
                        {
                            CloseRuleChoice();

                            int reroll =
                                DiceRoller.RollD6(
                                    rerollSource +
                                    " Advance re-roll: " +
                                    unit.DisplayName
                                );

                            ApplyAdvanceRoll(
                                unit,
                                reroll
                            );
                        }
                    )
                }
            );

            return;
        }

        ApplyAdvanceRoll(
            unit,
            roll
        );
    }

    private void ApplyAdvanceRoll(
        SquadController unit,
        int roll)
    {
        if (unit == null)
            return;

        unit.DeclareAdvance(
            roll
        );

        NotifyUnitAdvanced(
            unit);

        status =
            unit.DisplayName +
            " ADVANCES: +" +
            roll +
            " movement. It cannot charge this turn; in Shooting it can only use Assault weapons.";

        RefreshMoveRing();
    }

    private void TryMoveSelectedModel(Vector3 destination)
    {
        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            selectedModel == null ||
            !selectedModel.IsAlive)
        {
            return;
        }

        bool wasEngagedBeforeMove =
            IsEngaged(selectedSquad);

        List<SquadController> enemiesEngagedBeforeMove =
            wasEngagedBeforeMove
            ? EngagedEnemies(selectedSquad)
            : new List<SquadController>();

        if (wasEngagedBeforeMove)
            selectedSquad.HasFallenBack = true;
            NotifyUnitFellBack(selectedSquad);

        destination.y =
            selectedModel.transform.position.y;

        float displacement =
            selectedModel.DistanceMovedFromTurnStart(destination);

        float maxMove =
            selectedSquad
                .GetMovementAllowanceFor(
                    selectedModel
                );

        if (displacement > maxMove + 0.001f)
        {
            status =
                "Model move too far: " +
                displacement.ToString("0.0") +
                " / " +
                maxMove.ToString("0.0");
            return;
        }

        if (!InsideBoard(destination))
        {
            status = "Destination is off the board.";
            return;
        }

        if (!CanPlaceModel(selectedModel, destination))
        {
            status = "Cannot place that model there.";
            return;
        }

        NotifyMoveStarted(selectedSquad);

        selectedModel.transform.position = destination;

        NotifyMoveStarted(selectedSquad);

        selectedSquad.HasMoved = true;

        NotifyMoveEnded(selectedSquad);
        selectedSquad.RefreshVisuals();

        string coherence =
            selectedSquad.IsCoherent()
            ? "coherent"
            : "OUT OF COHERENCY";

        status =
            (selectedSquad.HasFallenBack
                ? "FALL BACK: "
                : (selectedSquad.HasAdvanced
                    ? "ADVANCE: "
                    : "")) +
            "Moved model " +
            displacement.ToString("0.0") +
            " from its start; squad is " +
            coherence +
            ".";

        RefreshMoveRing();
        RefreshObjectiveDisplays();

        System.Action afterMove =
            () =>
            {
                if (wasEngagedBeforeMove &&
                    !IsEngaged(selectedSquad))
                {
                    OfferOpportunitySeized(
                        selectedSquad,
                        enemiesEngagedBeforeMove
                    );
                }
            };

        if (!OfferSpiritMarkAfterMove(
                selectedSquad,
                afterMove))
        {
            afterMove();
        }
    }

    private void TryMoveWholeSquad(Vector3 destination)
    {
        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            !wholeSquadMoveMode ||
            !selectedSquad.IsAlive)
        {
            return;
        }

        bool wasEngagedBeforeMove =
            IsEngaged(selectedSquad);

        List<SquadController> enemiesEngagedBeforeMove =
            wasEngagedBeforeMove
            ? EngagedEnemies(selectedSquad)
            : new List<SquadController>();

        if (wasEngagedBeforeMove)
        {
            selectedSquad.HasFallenBack = true;
            NotifyUnitFellBack(selectedSquad);

            if (selectedSquad.AttachedLeader != null)
                selectedSquad.AttachedLeader.HasFallenBack = true;
        }

        List<ModelToken> joined =
            JoinedModels(selectedSquad);

        if (joined.Count == 0)
            return;

        Vector3 currentCentre =
            Vector3.zero;

        foreach (ModelToken model in joined)
            currentCentre += model.transform.position;

        currentCentre /= joined.Count;

        destination.y =
            currentCentre.y;

        Vector3 delta =
            destination -
            currentCentre;

        delta.y = 0f;

        if (!selectedSquad
            .CanTranslateWithinNormalMove(delta))
        {
            status =
                "Whole Attached-unit move rejected: at least one model (including the Leader) would exceed its own move allowance.";
            return;
        }

        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original =
            CaptureJoinedPositions(
                selectedSquad
            );

        TranslateJoinedModels(
            selectedSquad,
            delta
        );

        bool legal =
            AllModelsInsideBoard(
                selectedSquad
            ) &&
            AllModelsHaveLegalPlacement(
                selectedSquad
            ) &&
            selectedSquad.IsCoherent();

        if (!legal)
        {
            RestoreJoinedPositions(
                original
            );

            status =
                "Whole Attached-unit move rejected: collision, board edge, or joined-unit coherency problem.";
            return;
        }

        NotifyMoveStarted(selectedSquad);

        selectedSquad.HasMoved = true;

        NotifyMoveEnded(selectedSquad);

        if (selectedSquad.AttachedLeader != null)
            selectedSquad.AttachedLeader.HasMoved = true;

        status =
            (selectedSquad.HasFallenBack
                ? "FALL BACK: "
                : (selectedSquad.HasAdvanced
                    ? "ADVANCE: "
                    : "")) +
            "Moved " +
            (selectedSquad.AttachedLeader != null
                ? "Attached unit"
                : "whole squad") +
            " by " +
            HorizontalMagnitude(delta)
                .ToString("0.0") +
            ". Formation preserved.";

        RefreshMoveRing();
        RefreshObjectiveDisplays();

        System.Action afterMove =
            () =>
            {
                if (wasEngagedBeforeMove &&
                    !IsEngaged(selectedSquad))
                {
                    OfferOpportunitySeized(
                        selectedSquad,
                        enemiesEngagedBeforeMove
                    );
                }
            };

        if (!OfferSpiritMarkAfterMove(
                selectedSquad,
                afterMove))
        {
            afterMove();
        }
    }

    private bool CombatMovePathIsClear(
        ModelToken movingModel,
        Vector3 start,
        Vector3 destination,
        bool ignoreEnemyModels = false)
    {
        Vector3 flat =
            destination -
            start;

        flat.y = 0f;

        float distance =
            HorizontalMagnitude(flat);

        if (distance <= 0.001f)
            return true;

        int steps =
            Mathf.Max(
                2,
                Mathf.CeilToInt(
                    distance /
                    CombatPathSampleStep
                )
            );

        // Enemy models and terrain are solid during charge / pile-in /
        // consolidation. This prevents a model from "teleporting" through
        // the enemy unit to a legal-looking point on the far side.
        for (int i = 1; i <= steps; i++)
        {
            float t =
                i /
                (float)steps;

            Vector3 sample =
                Vector3.Lerp(
                    start,
                    destination,
                    t
                );

            if (!ignoreEnemyModels)
            {
                foreach (SquadController squad in squads)
                {
                    if (squad == null ||
                        !squad.IsOnBattlefield ||
                        squad.FactionId ==
                            movingModel.Squad.FactionId)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    foreach (ModelToken enemy
                        in squad.LivingModelTokens())
                    {
                        if (HorizontalDistance(
                                sample,
                                enemy.transform.position
                            ) <
                            MinimumModelSeparation(
                                movingModel,
                                enemy
                            ))
                        {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Vector3 terrainProbe =
                sample +
                Vector3.up * 0.4f;

            Collider[] overlaps =
                Physics.OverlapSphere(
                    terrainProbe,
                    0.28f
                );

            foreach (Collider col in overlaps)
            {
                if (col != null)
                {
                    TerrainFeature terrain =
                        col.GetComponent<TerrainFeature>();

                    if (terrain != null &&
                        terrain.BlocksMovement)
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void BeginSpecialMove(
        SquadController squad,
        float maximumDistance,
        string label,
        System.Action onComplete)
    {
        if (squad == null ||
            !squad.IsAlive ||
            !squad.IsOnBattlefield)
        {
            if (onComplete != null)
                onComplete();

            return;
        }

        specialMoveSquad =
            squad.JoinedActionController();

        specialMoveMaxDistance =
            Mathf.Max(
                0f,
                maximumDistance
            );

        specialMoveLabel =
            label ??
            "Special Move";

        specialMoveCompleted =
            onComplete;

        specialMoveIsSurge = false;
        specialMoveSurgeTarget = null;
        specialMoveSurgeStartDistance = 0f;

        ClearSelectionVisualOnly();
        selectedSquad = specialMoveSquad;
        selectedModel = null;
        wholeSquadMoveMode = true;
        specialMoveSquad.SetSelected(true);

        status =
            specialMoveLabel +
            ": click the board to move " +
            specialMoveSquad.DisplayName +
            " up to " +
            specialMoveMaxDistance.ToString("0.#") +
            ".";
    }

    private void BeginSurgeMove(
        SquadController squad,
        float maximumDistance,
        string label,
        System.Action onComplete)
    {
        if (squad == null ||
            !squad.IsAlive ||
            !squad.IsOnBattlefield ||
            squad.IsBattleShocked ||
            IsEngaged(squad))
        {
            if (onComplete != null)
                onComplete();

            return;
        }

        SquadController target =
            FindNearestEnemy(
                squad
            );

        if (target == null)
        {
            if (onComplete != null)
                onComplete();

            return;
        }

        BeginSpecialMove(
            squad,
            maximumDistance,
            label,
            onComplete
        );

        specialMoveIsSurge = true;
        specialMoveSurgeTarget =
            target.JoinedActionController();

        specialMoveSurgeStartDistance =
            JoinedDistance(
                specialMoveSquad,
                specialMoveSurgeTarget
            );

        status =
            specialMoveLabel +
            ": SURGE toward closest enemy " +
            specialMoveSurgeTarget.DisplayName +
            " up to " +
            specialMoveMaxDistance.ToString("0.#") +
            ". End closer, engage it if reachable, and do not engage another enemy.";
    }

    private void TryCompleteSpecialMove(
        Vector3 destination)
    {
        SquadController squad =
            specialMoveSquad;

        if (squad == null)
            return;

        List<ModelToken> joined =
            JoinedModels(squad);

        if (joined.Count == 0)
        {
            FinishSpecialMove();
            return;
        }

        Vector3 centre =
            Vector3.zero;

        foreach (ModelToken model in joined)
            centre += model.transform.position;

        centre /= joined.Count;

        destination.y = centre.y;

        Vector3 delta =
            destination - centre;

        delta.y = 0f;

        float distance =
            HorizontalMagnitude(delta);

        if (distance >
            specialMoveMaxDistance +
            0.001f)
        {
            status =
                specialMoveLabel +
                " move too far: " +
                distance.ToString("0.0") +
                " / " +
                specialMoveMaxDistance.ToString("0.0") +
                ".";
            return;
        }

        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original =
            CaptureJoinedPositions(
                squad
            );

        TranslateJoinedModels(
            squad,
            delta
        );

        bool legal =
            AllModelsInsideBoard(
                squad
            ) &&
            AllModelsHaveLegalPlacement(
                squad
            ) &&
            squad.IsCoherent();

        if (specialMoveIsSurge)
        {
            float endDistance =
                specialMoveSurgeTarget != null
                ? JoinedDistance(
                    squad,
                    specialMoveSurgeTarget
                  )
                : 999f;

            bool closer =
                endDistance <
                    specialMoveSurgeStartDistance -
                    0.001f;

            bool targetReachable =
                specialMoveSurgeStartDistance <=
                    specialMoveMaxDistance +
                    EngagementRange +
                    0.05f;

            bool engagedTarget =
                specialMoveSurgeTarget != null &&
                UnitsAreEngaged(
                    squad,
                    specialMoveSurgeTarget
                );

            bool engagedWrongEnemy =
                squads.Any(
                    enemy =>
                        enemy != null &&
                        enemy.IsAlive &&
                        enemy.IsOnBattlefield &&
                        enemy.FactionId !=
                            squad.FactionId &&
                        enemy.JoinedActionController() !=
                            specialMoveSurgeTarget &&
                        UnitsAreEngaged(
                            squad,
                            enemy
                        )
                );

            legal =
                legal &&
                closer &&
                !engagedWrongEnemy &&
                (!targetReachable ||
                 engagedTarget);
        }
        else
        {
            legal =
                legal &&
                !IsEngaged(
                    squad
                );
        }

        if (!legal)
        {
            RestoreJoinedPositions(
                original
            );

            status =
                specialMoveLabel +
                " rejected: collision, board edge, engagement or coherency problem.";
            return;
        }

        NotifyMoveStarted(squad);

        squad.HasMoved = true;

        NotifyMoveEnded(squad);

        if (squad.AttachedLeader != null)
            squad.AttachedLeader.HasMoved = true;

        RefreshObjectiveDisplays();

        status =
            specialMoveLabel +
            ": moved " +
            squad.DisplayName +
            " " +
            distance.ToString("0.0") +
            ".";

        FinishSpecialMove();
    }

    private void FinishSpecialMove()
    {
        System.Action callback =
            specialMoveCompleted;

        specialMoveSquad = null;
        specialMoveMaxDistance = 0f;
        specialMoveLabel = "";
        specialMoveCompleted = null;
        specialMoveIsSurge = false;
        specialMoveSurgeTarget = null;
        specialMoveSurgeStartDistance = 0f;

        ClearSelection();

        if (callback != null)
            callback();
    }

    private int ResolveForcedCoherencyLosses(
        SquadController unit,
        SquadController attacker)
    {
        if (unit == null)
            return 0;

        SquadController actionUnit =
            unit.JoinedActionController();

        int removed = 0;
        int guard = 0;

        while (actionUnit.IsAlive &&
               !actionUnit.IsCoherent() &&
               guard < 64)
        {
            guard++;

            List<ModelToken> invalid =
                actionUnit
                    .IncoherentModels();

            ModelToken casualty =
                invalid
                    .Where(
                        model =>
                            model != null &&
                            model.IsAlive
                    )
                    .OrderByDescending(
                        model =>
                            HorizontalDistance(
                                model.transform.position,
                                actionUnit.CurrentCentre()
                            )
                    )
                    .FirstOrDefault();

            if (casualty == null)
                break;

            casualty.ApplyDamage(
                casualty.CurrentWounds
            );

            RecordModelDestroyed(
                casualty,
                attacker
            );

            ResolveDeadlyDemise(
                casualty
            );

            removed++;
        }

        actionUnit.RefreshVisuals();

        if (actionUnit.AttachedLeader != null)
        {
            actionUnit.AttachedLeader
                .RefreshVisuals();
        }

        return removed;
    }

    private void AutoMoveSquadToward(
        SquadController mover,
        SquadController target,
        float maxDistance,
        float stopDistance)
    {
        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original =
            CaptureJoinedPositions(
                mover
            );

        foreach (ModelToken model
            in JoinedModels(mover))
        {
            Vector3 candidate;

            if (TryFindLegalCombatMove(
                model,
                target,
                maxDistance,
                stopDistance,
                out candidate))
            {
                model.transform.position =
                    candidate;

                Physics.SyncTransforms();
            }
        }

        if (!mover.IsCoherent() ||
            !AllModelsInsideBoard(mover) ||
            !AllModelsHaveLegalPlacement(mover))
        {
            RestoreJoinedPositions(
                original
            );
        }
        else
        {
            mover.RefreshVisuals();

            if (mover.AttachedLeader != null)
                mover.AttachedLeader.RefreshVisuals();
        }
    }

    private bool TryFindLegalCombatMove(
        ModelToken movingModel,
        SquadController target,
        float maxDistance,
        float stopDistance,
        out Vector3 result)
    {
        Vector3 from =
            movingModel.transform.position;

        float startingDistance =
            ModelDistanceToSquad(
                movingModel,
                target
            );

        List<ModelToken> targetModels =
            JoinedModels(target)
                .OrderBy(
                    model =>
                        HorizontalDistance(
                            from,
                            model.transform.position
                        )
                )
                .ToList();

        if (targetModels.Count == 0)
        {
            result = from;
            return false;
        }

        if (startingDistance <=
            stopDistance + 0.001f)
        {
            result = from;
            return true;
        }

        float[] angleOffsets =
        {
            0f,
            12f, -12f,
            24f, -24f,
            36f, -36f,
            48f, -48f,
            60f, -60f,
            72f, -72f,
            84f, -84f,
            96f, -96f,
            108f, -108f,
            120f, -120f,
            135f, -135f,
            150f, -150f,
            165f, -165f,
            180f
        };

        Vector3 best =
            from;

        float bestDistance =
            startingDistance;

        bool found = false;

        foreach (ModelToken targetModel
            in targetModels)
        {
            float desiredRadius =
                Mathf.Max(
                    stopDistance,
                    MinimumModelSeparation(
                        movingModel,
                        targetModel
                    ) +
                    0.08f
                );

            Vector3 targetPoint =
                targetModel.transform.position;

            Vector3 outward =
                from -
                targetPoint;

            outward.y = 0f;

            if (outward.sqrMagnitude <=
                0.0001f)
            {
                outward =
                    Vector3.back;
            }

            outward.Normalize();

            foreach (float angle
                in angleOffsets)
            {
                Vector3 radial =
                    Quaternion.Euler(
                        0f,
                        angle,
                        0f
                    ) *
                    outward;

                Vector3 desired =
                    targetPoint +
                    radial *
                    desiredRadius;

                desired.y = from.y;

                Vector3 delta =
                    desired -
                    from;

                delta.y = 0f;

                float requiredMove =
                    HorizontalMagnitude(
                        delta
                    );

                Vector3 candidate;

                if (requiredMove <=
                    maxDistance + 0.001f)
                {
                    candidate = desired;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (delta.sqrMagnitude <=
                        0.0001f)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    candidate =
                        from +
                        delta.normalized *
                        maxDistance;

                    candidate.y = from.y;
                }

                if (!InsideBoard(candidate))
                    continue;

                if (!CanPlaceModel(
                        movingModel,
                        candidate))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!CombatMovePathIsClear(
                        movingModel,
                        from,
                        candidate))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float endingDistance =
                    DistancePointToSquad(
                        candidate,
                        target
                    );

                if (endingDistance >=
                    startingDistance - 0.001f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!found ||
                    endingDistance <
                        bestDistance)
                {
                    found = true;
                    bestDistance =
                        endingDistance;
                    best = candidate;
                }
            }
        }

        result =
            found
            ? best
            : from;

        return found;
    }

    private bool ActiveFactionIsCoherent()
    {
        return squads
            .Where(
                squad =>
                    squad.IsAlive &&
                    squad.IsOnBattlefield &&
                    squad.FactionId == activeFaction
            )
            .All(
                squad =>
                    squad.IsCoherent()
            );
    }

    private SquadController FirstIncoherentSquad()
    {
        return squads.FirstOrDefault(
            squad =>
                squad.IsAlive &&
                squad.IsOnBattlefield &&
                squad.FactionId == activeFaction &&
                !squad.IsCoherent()
        );
    }

    private string CoherencyText()
    {
        int bad =
            squads.Count(
                squad =>
                    squad.IsAlive &&
                    squad.IsOnBattlefield &&
                    squad.FactionId == activeFaction &&
                    !squad.IsCoherent()
            );

        return bad == 0
            ? "Coherency: OK"
            : "Coherency: " +
              bad +
              " squad(s) invalid";
    }

}
